comments.@jiscribe/doc-schema: A devDependency: nothing here reads the schema at run time (validateDoc validates with the parser alone). __tests__/shippedPropertyNames.test.ts reads it as data, to hold the key constants to the shipped property names.
comments.@fontsource/*: Not imported as modules: the Node measurer reads the .woff files and the unicode-range of the @font-face CSS off disk, resolved through Node's own resolution (measure/fontSourcePackages.ts). They are the very files @jiscribe/canvas ships to the browser, which is what keeps a headless measurement on the same faces as the drawing.
